name: military-science-and-national-defence
description: Military Science and National Defence: what military science is, Clausewitz, Sun Tzu and other traditions, sea and air power, the levels of war, principles and their limits, manoeuvre, attrition and decision cycles, deterrence, nuclear strategy, escalation, alliances, grand strategy, force structure, logistics, doctrine and institutional learning, intelligence, command and control, defence procurement, unmanned systems, cyber and space, information operations, irregular warfare, total defence and societal resilience, civil-military relations, and the law of armed conflict.
